arguments.message:
Hi there,

If you see an API key you don’t recognize, you can revoke it right away: go to **Settings → Developer → API keys** and click **Revoke** next to the unknown key. Revoking stops any further use instantly.

After revoking, please let us know by replying here (or opening a support ticket) so we can start a security investigation and review the request logs to see what data may have been accessed.

Let us know if you need any help with the revocation process.

Thanks!
